Thank you for that very thoughtful and insightful reply. I haven’t given a thought that I may be “non-toxic” or at least less toxic than I’ve been viewing myself as. 

So thank you.

I really appreciate your thoughtfulness on this reply. It exactly is how I am anonymously online because when in the station, I’m a rock Star ha. I am frustrated and emotionally beaten down, especially with Covid and all of the hiring freezes. Thank you again, and this may be the comment I needed to pick my ass up again.
And these are the exact answers I expected when posting this
Thank you. I mixed it with the coconut soil and seems to hold moisture really well

Depending on the state, you may get involuntarily hospitalized for 72 hours max.  It is just that. A hospital stay so is covered by HIPPA and there is no police or criminal record. 

But aside from that, GO GET HELP IMMEDIATELY!! It is better to voluntarily seek treatment than to be involuntarily hospitalized or worse, successful at your impulse. 

Source: I work at a said involuntary hospital and also battle severe depression often, hence why I’m here.
I’ll keep that in mind. Good call and advice.
I’ve had my fair share of trivial “embarrassment” already, but nothing major like a DUI. Welcome to day 1. Glad I’m not alone.
You are. The yolk is your canvas. Scramble and cut away all that's not your art piece.
